question: How does the support of Nada and Sushumna pervade and move through the world?
premises: The support of Nada and Sushumna pierces this whole world.
It goes out below by the downward power.
It goes out above from the head by the upward power.
inference: The support of Nada and Sushumna pervades the entire world and moves in both downward and upward directions.
uncertainties: The verse uses an optative form, which may be descriptive or may carry an instructional nuance.
plain_english: The support of Nada and Sushumna pierces this whole world. By the downward power it goes out below, and by the upward power it goes out above from the head.
